answer: On a market supplying shale and pigment for a bridge, each settled trade irreversibly burns fee F in an externally valuable asset. Only after that burn is final may rebates, referrals and volume bonuses total at most F/2 in the same asset, across all recipients; there are no signup credits. A farm trading among its aliases recycles the purchase price internally but loses at least F/2 per trade. More names cannot raise the aggregate cap. This blocks direct subsidy farming, not actors willing to pay for fake volume or reputation.
